title: Fix ISO week number calculation at year boundaries
prompt: The function iso_week(date_str) in starter/iso_week.py accepts an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) and returns a tuple (iso_year, week_number) using the ISO 8601 definition. The starter uses the wrong strftime directives: it uses %Y (calendar year) instead of %G (ISO year) and %W (Monday-based week, 0-indexed) instead of %V (ISO week number). This causes wrong results at year boundaries. Fix it so that iso_week('2024-12-30') == (2025, 1), iso_week('2025-01-01') == (2025, 1), iso_week('2023-01-01') == (2022, 52). Do not edit the tests.
